title: 第25章 人啊要学会合理利用资源第26章 万年以来音修第一人虞既白
slug: 开局逼我献祭我有天道赐福
content_zh:
台下的人除了鼓掌，一时间说不出别的话。
温郗以练气九重，没有功法没有法器，只凭最单纯的灵力打穿了整个青云道院的筑基初期，并越阶战胜了一位筑基中期。
温郗从台子上走下来时，不出意外地被墨微尘几人拦住了。
她扬起一抹乖巧的笑容：“弟子温郗见过诸位峰主。”
墨微尘：“萧温郗，你是不是要不了多久就能筑基了？要不要来我们神机峰？我可以给你保驾护航。”
秦优眉毛一竖，一胳膊肘给墨微尘怼了个趔趄。
秦优：“别听他瞎说，他这人最不靠谱了。”
墨微尘微微皱眉。
冷千双冷哼一声：“看看你们两个像什么样子，丢不丢人。”
“萧温郗，”冷千双看向乖巧的小姑娘，语气严肃，“你就踏踏实实地修炼，不用想那些有的别的。”
“不过，”他话锋一转，“以你的境界，也确实该考虑一下将来修炼何种道法了。”
温郗立刻拱手：“弟子知道，必定会好好考虑，不负青云道院的期望。”
冷千双轻咳一声，压低声音：“那个，萧杙是你哥哥吧？他可是打算做个剑修的，你也好好想想。”
“绝不是诱导你的意思！我青云道院有规定绝不干扰弟子的任何选择，我可不是墨微尘那种人。”冷千双坚毅的脸上飞快地闪过一抹红，有些欲盖弥彰。
墨微尘：……
这个死冰块给他等着。
温郗：“……我明白，多谢冷峰主指点。”
她歪头调皮地笑了笑，语气真挚：“其实我觉得提前接触一下五大峰的情况挺好的，因为我自己对五种道法一直很好奇，都有点等不到筑基了呢。”
墨微尘闻言，眼中闪过一抹思绪，嘴里却说着：“好了好了，散了散了，我要去找小白了。”
秦优：“对啊，谁也不准暗中提前勾搭温郗啊。”

温郗俯身拱手：“拜别诸位峰主。”
感受到几人离去，温郗直起身，嘴角的笑容不变。
看，这不就一下吸引到所有峰主的注意力了吗？
凭她在新生手册上看到的介绍，墨微尘不常收徒，迄今为止也就收过五六个，还都已经毕业了。
但他只要遇上中意的弟子是一定会招揽到自己的神机峰的，提前招收未筑基弟子的事他也是干过的。
自己今天整这么一出，再加上那句暗示，足以让墨微尘意识到其它峰峰主也在对她虎视眈眈，他会急的。
剩下的一切都不用她再操心。
她妈妈说过，人要学会合理利用身边的一切资源。
人心，人性，舆论，财物……
都是。
温郗垂眸看着自己的掌心，距离任务截止时间还有三天。
她本来想着如果一个月内可以成功筑基在拜师会上完成“人群中心”成就，但现在来看，仅剩的三天不足以让她突破。
她这才选择了利用决斗场吸引视线，并希望能借此让几个峰主提前收徒。
萧杙和鹿辞霜想要跟温郗说些什么，却只见她脚步极快地朝着宿舍楼走去。
鹿辞霜：“我要不要去追她？”
萧杙微微摇头：“不用了，她更喜欢一个人独处，你追上去反而影响她疗伤。”
幸好，顾千远给小郗带了不少丹药。
鹿辞霜撇了撇嘴：“行行行，就你最了解她~”
content_en:
The people in the audience couldn't say anything except applauding.
With the ninth level of qi training, Wen Xi had no skills or magical weapons, and only relied on the purest spiritual power to penetrate the entire early foundation building of Qingyun Taoist Temple, and defeated a mid-level foundation building master by leapfrogging the level.
When Wen Xi walked down from the stage, he was stopped by Mo Weichen and others as expected.
She raised a cute smile and said, "Disciple Wen Xi has met all the peak masters."
Mo Weichen: "Xiao Wenxi, will you be able to build the foundation soon? Do you want to come to our Divine Machine Peak? I can escort you."
Qin You's eyebrows were raised, and Mo Weichen staggered with his elbow.
Qin You: "Don't listen to his nonsense. He is the most unreliable person."
Mo Weichen frowned slightly.
Leng Qianshuang snorted coldly: "Look at what you two look like, are you embarrassed?"
"Xiao Wenxi," Leng Qianshuang looked at the well-behaved little girl and said in a serious tone, "Just practice in a down-to-earth manner and don't think about other things."
"However," he changed the topic, "Given your level, you should really consider what kind of Taoism you will practice in the future."
Wen Xi immediately handed over his hand: "Disciple knows that he will definitely consider it carefully and live up to the expectations of Qingyun Taoist Academy."
Leng Qianshuang coughed lightly and lowered her voice: "Um, Xiao Zhu is your brother, right? He plans to become a swordsman, so you should think about it carefully."
"I definitely don't mean to induce you! Our Qingyun Taoist Academy has a rule that we will never interfere with any of the disciples' choices. I am not the kind of person Mo Weichen is." A flash of red quickly flashed across Leng Qianshuang's resolute face, which was somewhat concealed.
Mo Weichen:......
This dead ice cube is waiting for him.
Wen Xi: "...I understand, thank you Peak Master Leng for your guidance."
She tilted her head and smiled mischievously, with a sincere tone: "Actually, I think it's good to get in touch with the situation of the five peaks in advance, because I have always been very curious about the five Taoist methods, and I can't wait to build the foundation."
When Mo Weichen heard the words, a flash of thought flashed in his eyes, but he said: "Okay, okay, it's time to go, I'm going to find Xiaobai."
Qin You: "Yes, no one is allowed to hook up with Wen Xi secretly in advance."
Wen Xi leaned over and cupped his hands: "Farewell to all peak masters."
Feeling the departure of several people, Wen Xi straightened up, the smile on his lips unchanged.
Look, doesn’t this attract the attention of all the peak masters at once?
Based on the introduction she saw in the freshman handbook, Mo Weichen didn't often take on apprentices. He had only taken on five or six apprentices so far, and they had all graduated.
But as long as he meets a disciple he likes, he will definitely recruit him to the Divine Machine Peak. He has also done this before recruiting disciples who have not yet established their foundation.
What she did today, coupled with that hint, was enough to make Mo Weichen realize that the other peak masters were also eyeing her, and he would be anxious.
She didn't have to worry about the rest.
Her mother said that people should learn to make rational use of all the resources around them.
People's hearts, humanity, public opinion, property...
All.
Wen Xi lowered his eyes and looked at his palm. There were still three days before the task deadline.
She originally thought that if she could successfully build the foundation within a month and complete the "Crowd Center" achievement at the apprenticeship meeting, but now looking at it, the only three days left are not enough for her to make a breakthrough.
She then chose to use the duel field to attract attention, hoping to use this to get several peak leaders to accept disciples in advance.
Xiao Zhu and Lu Cishuang wanted to say something to Wen Xi, but they saw her walking towards the dormitory building very quickly.
Lu Cishuang: "Should I chase her?"
Xiao Zhu shook his head slightly: "No, she prefers to be alone. If you chase her, it will affect her healing."
Fortunately, Gu Qianyuan brought a lot of pills to Xiao Xi.
Lu Cishuang curled her lips: "Okay, okay, you know her best~"
